verdict.rationale: Fellow's core product delivers automatic post-meeting summaries with key points, decisions, action items, and topic-based minutes (fellow-docs-23, fellow-docs-51, fellow-docs-52), which directly matches the PM's need for a shareable, structured recap. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that summaries are consistently accurate enough to share without any editing, and no third-party review evidence beyond vendor docs/marketing.
